title: Beyond Task Completion: Measuring Interaction Cost in Terminal User Interfaces

paragraphs.en: With rapid advances in large language models (LLMs), terminal user interfaces (TUIs) have become increasingly popular for development and operations. Successfully completing a task through a TUI does not mean that the task is easy to perform. Because task success alone does not fully capture TUI usability, evaluation should also measure the effort involved in understanding and operating the interface. Despite this growing adoption, research on TUIs remains limited, and no prior work has systematically evaluated their usability. Existing usability assessments rely mainly on costly human assessment or LLM-generated ratings and reports. Neither provides a repeatable measure of task-level interaction effort grounded in actual task execution.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，终端用户界面（TUI）在开发和运维中变得越来越流行。 通过 TUI 成功完成一项任务，并不意味着这项任务本身容易执行。 由于仅凭任务成功与否无法全面反映 TUI 的可用性，评估还应衡量理解和操作该界面所需的努力程度。 尽管 TUI 的应用日益广泛，但相关研究仍然有限，且此前没有任何工作对其可用性进行过系统性评估。 现有的可用性评估主要依赖成本高昂的人工评估，或基于 LLM 生成的评分和报告。 这两种方法都无法提供以实际任务执行为基础的、可重复的任务级交互努力度衡量标准。

paragraphs.en: We construct TUINaut-Bench and conduct an empirical study of 84 tasks across 15 real-world TUIs. The study includes six human participants, five observation–evaluator configurations, and we apply the paradigm to 45 TUIs independently generated by three leading generation stacks. We find that similar aggregate success rates can mask substantial differences in which tasks humans and agents complete, whereas their interpretation and operation costs follow correlated task rankings, especially for operation. Across all five observation–evaluator configurations, completion correspondence remains weak while cost rankings remain aligned. TUIs generated by current leading agent frameworks can implement correct functionality, yet their task-based usability still needs improvement. These findings position Agent-as-a-User as a repeatable and execution-grounded paradigm for measuring task-based usability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 TUINaut-Bench，并对 15 个真实世界 TUI 中的 84 项任务进行了实证研究。 该研究包括六名人类参与者、五种观察–评估者配置，并将这一范式应用于由三大主流生成框架独立生成的 45 个 TUI。 我们发现，相似的总体成功率可能掩盖了人类与智能体在任务完成方面的显著差异，而它们的解释与操作成本则呈现出相关的任务排名，尤其是在操作方面。 在所有五种观察–评估者配置中，任务完成的对应性仍然较弱，但成本排名始终保持一致。 当前主流智能体框架生成的 TUI 能够实现正确的功能，但其基于任务的可用性仍需改进。 这些发现确立了“智能体即用户”这一范式，使其成为衡量基于任务的可用性的可重复且以执行为基础的评估方法。

paragraphs.en: The spread of large language models (LLMs) has given terminal user interfaces (TUIs) a larger role in development and operations. These interfaces now take many forms, such as file managers, system monitors, database clients, version-control tools, and coding agents ( Peng et al., 2026a ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Rocha, 2023 ; Anthropic, 2025 ) . Compared with conventional graphical user interfaces (GUIs), TUIs render their interfaces in terminals and rely more heavily on keyboard input, often through mode-dependent keys with limited visible cues. These characteristics make it important to study how easily users can complete concrete tasks. However, research on TUI usability remains limited.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的普及使终端用户界面（TUI）在开发和运维中扮演了更重要的角色。 如今，这些界面呈现出多种形态，例如文件管理器、系统监控器、数据库客户端、版本控制工具以及编码智能体（Peng et al., 2026a ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Rocha, 2023 ; Anthropic, 2025）。 与传统的图形用户界面（GUI）相比，TUI 在终端中渲染其界面，并且更依赖键盘输入，通常通过模式相关的按键实现，而可见提示则较为有限。 这些特性使得研究用户完成具体任务的便捷性变得尤为重要。 然而，关于 TUI 可用性的研究仍然有限。

paragraphs.en: How easily users can complete a task depends on the cues exposed by the interface. Fig. 1 compares two file-manager designs for the same goals. In the lower design, guided navigation in Fig. 1 (a) reveals that more entries lie below and indicates where to scroll. Immediate feedback in Fig. 1 (b) confirms that the search has started. Visible prompts in Fig. 1 (c) expose the keys for delete and quit. The upper design omits these cues, forcing users to scan blindly, try actions, and infer whether those actions succeeded. The same tasks can therefore impose different demands on understanding the interface and acting through it.
paragraphs.zh: 用户完成一项任务有多容易，取决于界面所提供的提示。 图 1 对比了为实现相同目标而设计的两种文件管理器。 在下方的设计中，图 1 (a) 中的引导式导航显示下方还有更多条目，并指明了应滚动的位置。 图 1 (b) 中的即时反馈确认了搜索已经开始。 图 1 (c) 中可见的提示显示了删除和退出功能的按键。 上方的设计省略了这些提示，迫使用户盲目浏览、尝试操作，并推断这些操作是否成功。 因此，相同的任务可能对理解界面和通过界面执行操作提出不同的要求。

paragraphs.en: These examples show that task completion alone cannot characterize task-based usability . We therefore consider two complementary forms of evidence from actual executions: task completion, which records whether the goal is reached, and interaction cost, which captures the demands of interpreting the interface state and carrying out the next action.
paragraphs.zh: 这些例子表明，仅凭任务完成度无法全面描述基于任务的可用性。 因此，我们从实际执行中考虑两种互补的证据形式：任务完成度（记录目标是否达成）和交互成本（反映解读界面状态和执行下一步操作所需付出的努力）。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, software evaluation still focuses primarily on correctness ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Zan et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2025 ) , and usability assessments leave the interaction cost of a task unmeasured. Existing usability assessments rely mainly on human studies or LLM-generated ratings and reports. Human studies can reveal interaction friction and subjective experience, but they are expensive to repeat across applications and revisions and difficult to scale ( Ivory and Hearst, 2001 ; Nielsen and Landauer, 1993 ; Jeffries et al., 1991 ; Kuang et al., 2022 ) . Recent LLM-based systems simulate users, generate think-aloud reports, predict ratings, or organize UX feedback ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Griesbach et al., 2026 ; Holter et al., 2026 ) . These systems provide useful qualitative evidence, but their ratings and reports remain judgments rather than measurements grounded in verified task execution. Therefore, existing approaches do not provide a repeatable measure of interaction cost grounded in actual task execution.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，软件评估仍然主要关注正确性（Jimenez 等，2024；Deng 等，2025；Zan 等，2025；Jain 等，2025），而可用性评估则未能衡量任务的交互成本。 现有的可用性评估主要依赖人类研究或大型语言模型生成的评分和报告。 人类研究能够揭示交互中的摩擦和主观体验，但在不同应用和版本中重复进行成本高昂，且难以扩展（Ivory 和 Hearst，2001；Nielsen 和 Landauer，1993；Jeffries 等，1991；Kuang 等，2022）。 近期基于大型语言模型的系统能够模拟用户、生成出声思考报告、预测评分或整理用户体验反馈（Lu 等，2025；Griesbach 等，2026；Holter 等，2026）。 这些系统提供了有用的定性证据，但其评分和报告仍然是判断，而非基于经验证的任务执行过程得出的测量结果。 因此，现有方法并未提供一个基于实际任务执行的、可重复的交互成本衡量标准。

paragraphs.en: To address this measurement problem, we propose Agent-as-a-User , an evaluation paradigm that places an LLM agent in the user role to evaluate task-based TUI usability. The agent executes each task under a fixed configuration, with a fresh context and keyboard actions only. Under this setup, the agent serves as a controlled experimental instrument that observes the same rendered TUI and acts through the same application input boundary as a human user. Building on the classical Keystroke-Level Model (KLM), we introduce Agent-KLM , an analytical model that separates agent-side interpretation cost and operation cost and relates them structurally to human interaction. We implement TUINaut , a framework that records realized interaction trajectories and verifies task outcomes using actor-independent oracles. Together, the paradigm, analytical model, and framework support an empirical study organized around three research questions. RQ1 asks whether agent completion and the two costs correspond to human interaction on the same tasks. RQ2 asks whether that correspondence still holds for plain, semantic, and image observations, because humans and agents differ most in what they see. RQ3 applies the paradigm to the task-based usability of TUIs generated by three leading coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一测量问题，我们提出了“智能体即用户”（Agent-as-a-User）评估范式，该范式将大型语言模型智能体置于用户角色中，以评估基于任务的TUI可用性。 智能体在固定配置下执行每项任务，仅使用全新的上下文和键盘操作。 在此设置下，智能体充当受控的实验工具，观察相同的渲染TUI，并通过与人类用户相同的应用程序输入边界进行交互。 基于经典的按键级模型（KLM），我们引入了“智能体-KLM”（Agent-KLM）分析模型，该模型将智能体侧的解释成本和操作成本分离，并将其与人类交互建立结构性关联。 我们实现了TUINaut框架，该框架可记录实际的交互轨迹，并通过与执行者无关的预言机验证任务结果。 综合而言，这一评估范式、分析模型和框架共同支持了一项围绕三个研究问题的实证研究。 研究问题1（RQ1）旨在探究智能体完成任务的情况及两种成本是否与人类在相同任务中的交互相对应。 研究问题2（RQ2）旨在探究这种对应关系是否同样适用于纯文本、语义和图像观察，因为人类与智能体的最大差异在于所见内容。 研究问题3（RQ3）将这一范式应用于由三种主流编码智能体生成的TUI的基于任务的可用性评估。

sents.en: Building on the classical Keystroke-Level Model (KLM), we introduce Agent-KLM , an analytical model that separates agent-side interpretation cost and operation cost and relates them structurally to human interaction.
sents.zh: 基于经典的按键级模型（KLM），我们引入了“智能体-KLM”（Agent-KLM）分析模型，该模型将智能体侧的解释成本和操作成本分离，并将其与人类交互建立结构性关联。

sents.en: We implement TUINaut , a framework that records realized interaction trajectories and verifies task outcomes using actor-independent oracles.
sents.zh: 我们实现了TUINaut框架，该框架可记录实际的交互轨迹，并通过与执行者无关的预言机验证任务结果。

sents.en: Together, the paradigm, analytical model, and framework support an empirical study organized around three research questions.
sents.zh: 综合而言，这一评估范式、分析模型和框架共同支持了一项围绕三个研究问题的实证研究。

sents.en: RQ1 asks whether agent completion and the two costs correspond to human interaction on the same tasks.
sents.zh: 研究问题1（RQ1）旨在探究智能体完成任务的情况及两种成本是否与人类在相同任务中的交互相对应。

sents.en: RQ2 asks whether that correspondence still holds for plain, semantic, and image observations, because humans and agents differ most in what they see.
sents.zh: 研究问题2（RQ2）旨在探究这种对应关系是否同样适用于纯文本、语义和图像观察，因为人类与智能体的最大差异在于所见内容。

sents.en: RQ3 applies the paradigm to the task-based usability of TUIs generated by three leading coding agents.
sents.zh: 研究问题3（RQ3）将这一范式应用于由三种主流编码智能体生成的TUI的基于任务的可用性评估。

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions, we construct TUINaut-Bench with 84 tasks across 15 real-world TUIs. The study includes six human participants, five observation–evaluator configurations spanning plain, semantic, and image input, 3,528 agent attempts, and 45 TUIs independently generated by the three stacks.

paragraphs.en: The results show that similar aggregate success rates can hide substantial differences in which tasks humans and agents complete. By contrast, their interpretation and operation costs follow correlated task rankings, with the strongest relationship for operation. This pattern recurs across the five configurations even though completion correspondence remains weak. Applying Agent-as-a-User to generated TUIs further shows that correct functionality can coexist with higher interpretation cost and no consistent operation advantage. Together, these findings position Agent-as-a-User as a repeatable and execution-grounded paradigm for measuring task-based usability.

It makes this difference explicit by decomposing a task method into elementary operators, where each operator denotes a primitive unit of user activity ( Card et al., 2018 ) . The keystroke operator ( K K ) denotes a key or button press. Pointing ( P P ) moves a pointer to a target, homing ( H H ) moves the hands between input devices, and drawing ( D D ) traces a path. The mental-preparation operator ( M M ) precedes an action or action chunk, while response ( R R ) is system processing that blocks the next action. paragraphs.en: We begin with a broad GitHub search for TUI repositories created in 2026. This cutoff is intended to minimize potential overlap with model pretraining data while retaining a sufficiently large pool for screening. The queries use the tui and terminal-ui tags, supplemented by TUI framework names and application terms. The search returns 1,980 unique repositories. 2 2 2 We conducted the repository crawl in May 2026. Requiring more than 50 stars leaves 274 candidates. Two authors then independently install and conduct hands-on evaluations of all 274 candidates, following their README workflows to check the claimed core functionality. This evaluation identifies candidates that launch reliably in Docker and whose main interactive features work as documented.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先对 GitHub 进行了广泛搜索，查找 2026 年创建的 TUI 仓库。 这一时间截点旨在尽可能减少与模型预训练数据可能存在的重叠，同时保留足够大的候选池以供筛选。 搜索查询使用了 tui 和 terminal-ui 标签，并辅以 TUI 框架名称和应用相关术语。 此次搜索返回了 1,980 个唯一仓库。2 2 2 我们在 2026 年 5 月执行了仓库抓取。 要求仓库获得超过 50 颗星星后，剩余 274 个候选项目。 随后，两位作者独立安装并对全部 274 个候选项目进行了实际评估，遵循其 README 中的工作流程，以验证所声明的核心功能。 通过这项评估，我们筛选出了那些能在 Docker 中稳定启动且主要交互功能符合文档说明的候选项目。

paragraphs.en: From this pool, we select 50 applications covering diverse domains and interaction patterns for in-depth examination using four criteria. (1) Verifiability: completion states are externally verifiable. (2) Reproducibility: repeating the same workflow from the same initial state produces consistent outcomes. (3) Discoverability: essential operations are discoverable within the TUI without external instructions. (4) Diversity: the selected set covers varied functionality and interaction patterns. When multiple repositories offer substantially similar functionality, we retain only one so that the final set includes a wider variety of TUIs. The two authors then compare and discuss their assessments in depth before jointly selecting 15 repositories. A third evaluator then independently verifies that each selected application launches and that its principal functions work as documented. Importantly, our final selection follows these four criteria and does not use subjective judgments of ease of use, which would narrow the range of TUIs represented in TUINaut-Bench .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从这个候选池中挑选出 50 个涵盖不同领域和交互模式的应用程序，依据四个标准进行深度评估。 (1) 可验证性：完成状态可以被外部验证。 (2) 可重复性：从相同的初始状态重复执行相同的工作流程，会产生一致的结果。 (3) 可发现性：关键操作无需外部指令即可在 TUI 内部被发现。 (4) 多样性：所选集合涵盖了多样的功能与交互模式。 当多个存储库提供基本相似的功能时，我们仅保留其中一个，以确保最终集合包含更广泛的 TUI 类型。 随后，两位作者深入比较并讨论各自的评估结果，再共同选出 15 个存储库。 接着，第三位评估者独立验证每个入选应用程序能否启动，以及其主要功能是否按文档所述正常运行。 重要的是，我们的最终选择遵循上述四个标准，并未采用对易用性的主观判断，否则将缩小 TUINaut-Bench 中所涵盖 TUI 的范围。

paragraphs.en: For reproducibility, we pin each repository’s commit SHA and dependency versions. We also write a Dockerfile that installs its dependencies and provides a reproducible execution environment ( Boettiger, 2014 ) . Over two months, the two authors carefully discuss and manually design all 84 tasks around each TUI’s distinctive characteristics and principal functionality. Each task package includes an initialization script that establishes the starting state, a task description that specifies the user goal, task fixtures that supply the required data, and oracle assertions that verify completion, as shown in Fig. 3 (a). For each task, we complete the intended workflow by operating the TUI inside its Docker container and derive the oracle assertions from the expected final state. We manually repeat every task at least five times, at different times and on different machines, to confirm that it is reproducible and has a reachable successful path. We also verify that the information available within the TUI is sufficient to complete the task.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保可重复性，我们固定了每个仓库的提交 SHA 和依赖版本。 我们还编写了一个 Dockerfile，用于安装依赖项并提供一个可重复的执行环境（Boettiger, 2014）。 在两个多月的时间里，两位作者围绕每个 TUI 的独特特性和主要功能，对所有 84 个任务进行了细致的讨论和手动设计。 每个任务包都包含一个初始化脚本（用于建立初始状态）、一个任务描述（用于明确用户目标）、任务固定数据（用于提供所需数据）以及预言机断言（用于验证任务完成），如第 3 图 (a) 所示。 对于每个任务，我们通过在其 Docker 容器内操作 TUI 来完成预期的工作流程，并从预期的最终状态中推导出预言机断言。 我们手动重复执行每个任务至少五次，且在不同时间和不同机器上进行，以确认其可重复性并验证是否存在可达的成功路径。 我们还验证了 TUI 内部提供的信息是否足以完成任务。

paragraphs.en: To support controlled generation of comparable TUIs, we construct one repository-level prompt for each selected application. Two authors manually derive each specification from the README, hands-on inspection, the functionality covered by its tasks, the technology stack, and the execution environment. Following recent machine-assisted benchmark construction and validation practices ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Badertdinov et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , an LLM helps organize this material under a shared template covering the project scenario, required capabilities, technical and environmental constraints, UI guidelines, and delivery rules. The two authors independently check each draft against the source materials and finalize it only after confirming that all required capabilities are clearly stated. The prompts specify only the required functionality and development constraints, without exposing benchmark tasks or the implementation and interaction design of the reference TUI. We release all 15 prompts as part of TUINaut-Bench .

paragraphs.en: Overall, TUINaut-Bench contains 84 tasks and 15 generation prompts across 15 repositories created between January and May 2026. 3 3 3 All benchmark data, including detailed statistics, are available in our repository and web page.

paragraphs.en: TUINaut-Bench provides the applications and task assets, while TUINaut turns them into executable and verifiable evaluations. Fig. 3 summarizes this process in three stages.
paragraphs.zh: TUINaut-Bench 提供应用程序和任务资产，而 TUINaut 则将其转化为可执行且可验证的评估。 图 3 将这一过程总结为三个阶段。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 3 (a), TUINaut prepares each task in an isolated Docker environment and exposes its TUI through a host-managed Tmux session ( Marriott, 2026 ) . It first starts the benchmark image as a long-lived Docker container and materializes the task fixtures at their designated paths in the Docker sandbox. TUINaut then runs docker exec -it from the Tmux session to start the task through a persistent interactive terminal shared by human and agent execution. Inside the container, the entrypoint runs the initialization script to reset task state, configure the environment, and prepare the fixture data before launching the TUI. Provisioning finishes when the initial screen is rendered. Every run therefore begins with the pinned application configuration, initialized fixtures, and a clean task state. Section 3.3 details the shared mechanisms used for subsequent human and agent execution.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 3 (a) 所示，TUINaut 在隔离的 Docker 环境中准备每个任务，并通过主机管理的 Tmux 会话暴露其 TUI（Marriott, 2026）。 它首先将基准测试镜像启动为一个长期运行的 Docker 容器，并在 Docker 沙盒中将其任务固定文件实例化到指定路径。 接着，TUINaut 通过 Tmux 会话运行 docker exec -it，以在人类和智能体执行共享的持久交互式终端中启动任务。 在容器内部，入口点会运行初始化脚本，以重置任务状态、配置环境并在启动 TUI 之前准备固定数据。 当初始屏幕渲染完成时，准备工作即告结束。 因此，每次运行都始于固定的应用程序配置、已初始化的固定文件以及干净的任务状态。 第 3.3 节详细说明了后续人类和智能体执行所共享的机制。

paragraphs.en: In addition, to reduce false positives from oracle assertions that might otherwise accept a generic or accidentally reached state, TUINaut uses task fingerprints as an additional safeguard. We examine every task and apply fingerprints wherever its inputs and expected outcome can naturally incorporate a task-specific marker, resulting in 30 of the 84 tasks. For each such task, the fingerprint generator derives short tokens from a SHA-256 hash of the project and task identifiers. As required by each task, TUINaut substitutes these tokens into the initialization script, task fixtures, oracle assertions, and task description. The expected token thus becomes part of both the task instance and its completion criteria, allowing the oracle to verify the intended task-specific result.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，为了减少来自神谕断言的误报——这些断言原本可能会接受一个通用状态或意外达到的状态——TUINaut 使用任务指纹作为额外的保障措施。 我们检查了每一项任务，并在其输入和预期结果能够自然融入任务特定标记的地方应用了这些指纹，最终在 84 项任务中确定了 30 项。 对于每一项这样的任务，指纹生成器会从项目标识符和任务标识符的 SHA-256 哈希值中提取短令牌。 根据每项任务的要求，TUINaut 会把这些令牌替换到初始化脚本、任务夹具、神谕断言以及任务描述中。 因此，预期令牌既成为任务实例的一部分，也成为其完成标准的一部分，从而让神谕能够验证预期的任务特定结果。

paragraphs.en: For the human user, the running TUI first renders the screen. The user views this screen with human eyes, and the human brain interprets it. The user then presses keys as physical key events, which reach the TUI as terminal input. For the keyboard agent, capture pane obtains a TUI screenshot of the same rendered screen. The LLM core updates context from this screenshot and generates an action. Tmux send-keys then issues those keys as virtual key events, which likewise reach the TUI as terminal input. The TUI renders the updated screen for the next observation, and either role continues this loop until submit / exit. TUINaut records the resulting screen–key trajectory for either role. During this process, TUINaut records the timestamp of every physical or virtual key event for later analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 对于人类用户，正在运行的 TUI 首先渲染屏幕。 用户使用肉眼观察这个屏幕，而人类大脑则对其进行解读。 随后，用户按下按键，产生物理按键事件，这些事件以终端输入的形式传入 TUI。 对于键盘智能体，捕获面板会获取同一渲染屏幕的 TUI 截图。 LLM 核心会根据这张截图更新上下文，并生成一个动作。 接着，Tmux send-keys 会将这些按键作为虚拟按键事件发出，它们同样以终端输入的形式传入 TUI。 TUI 会渲染更新后的屏幕以供下一次观察，然后任一角色都会继续这个循环，直到提交或退出。 TUINaut 会记录任一角色由此产生的屏幕–按键轨迹。 在此过程中，TUINaut 会记录每个物理或虚拟按键事件的时间戳，以便后续分析。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 3 (c), once either the human user or keyboard agent submits the task or exits the TUI, TUINaut activates the verification engine without sending a further key to the TUI. Shell-state and filesystem assertions query the resulting Docker state through docker exec , whereas screen assertions inspect the final host Tmux pane. The aggregate result is PASS only when every assertion passes and FAIL otherwise.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 details the six assertion primitives used to compose each task-specific oracle. (1) Shell-state assertions: check_shell executes a command in the container and compares its output with the expected output. (2) Filesystem assertions: check_filesystem searches configured roots for a file containing the specified path and content tokens. check_filesystem_content searches for content without constraining the path. (3) Screen assertions: check_screen verifies that specified text appears on the final screen. check_screen_absent verifies that specified text does not appear. check_screen_highlight verifies that specified text is visually highlighted. Detailed implementations of these checks are available in our repository.

paragraphs.en: In the host Tmux session , Tmux creates an interactive pane and its pseudo-terminal (PTY). A PTY provides a bidirectional interface that lets a process communicate as if it were attached to a conventional terminal ( Linux man-pages Project, 2026 ) . A human enters physical keystrokes into this pane, whereas the agent injects virtual keys with Tmux send-keys . To connect this pane to the Docker sandbox , TUINaut invokes docker exec -it . paragraphs.en: Each turn instantiates one tuple ( o i , r i , a i ) (o_{i},r_{i},a_{i}) . Observation. The host-side Interaction Controller captures the current Tmux screen and encodes it using one of three observation representations. The plain representation preserves the visible terminal characters and layout as unstyled text. The semantic representation augments the same text with XML-like <fg:color> and <bg:color> tags that encode ANSI foreground and background colors. The image representation renders the terminal screen as a PNG image. The controller then adds o i o_{i} to the LLM context. Interpretation. The LLM interprets the current observation in light of the interaction so far, and we record the reasoning tokens it produces as r i r_{i} . Action. The agent must emit exactly one a i a_{i} from the four permitted actions: type , press , submit , or wait . The controller rejects any other output as invalid. It executes a valid action and, when the interaction continues, captures the resulting screen to begin the next turn.

paragraphs.en: Three of these actions align with human behavior at the shared execution boundary. The agent uses type to enter a literal text string and press to issue a functional key or key combination, such as or + . This separation distinguishes textual input from keyboard commands. The agent uses submit to express the same completion decision as a human submission, and the controller intercepts it rather than delivering it to the TUI. When processing may still be underway, wait pauses and captures the screen again without sending another key.
paragraphs.zh: 这些操作中有三项与共享执行边界处的人类行为一致。 智能体使用 type 键输入一个文本字符串，然后按某个键或键组合（例如 or +）来发出功能指令。 这种分离将文本输入与键盘命令区分开来。 智能体使用 submit 键来表达与人类提交相同的完成决策，而控制器会拦截该操作，而不是将其传递给 TUI。 当处理可能仍在进行中的时候，wait 会暂停并再次捕获屏幕，而不会发送其他按键。

paragraphs.en: To keep this loop within the task-execution role, each task uses a fresh LLM context containing only the task description and action protocol. paragraphs.en: We implement a human experiment harness for macOS and Linux that mirrors the keyboard agent setup in task initialization, sandboxed execution, oracle verification, and trajectory logging. The principal difference is observation delivery: participants view the Tmux pane directly in a maximized desktop terminal rather than receiving an encoded screen representation. Mouse input is disabled to preserve the shared keyboard boundary. The harness maps three consecutive + inputs to the submit action defined in Section 3.4.1 and excludes these control inputs from subsequent interaction statistics. All other keystrokes are delivered to the TUI through the physical keyboard, and the harness records a timestamp for every event.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 macOS 和 Linux 实现了一套人类实验框架，该框架复现了任务初始化中的键盘智能体配置，包括沙盒执行、神谕验证和轨迹记录。 主要区别在于观察信息的传递：参与者直接在最大化的桌面终端中查看 Tmux 面板，而不是接收编码后的屏幕表示。 为保持共享的键盘边界，鼠标输入已被禁用。 该框架将三个连续的 + 输入映射到第 3.4.1 节中定义的提交操作，并将这些控制输入排除在后续交互统计之外。 所有其他按键操作都通过物理键盘传递到 TUI，且该框架会记录每个事件的时间戳。

paragraphs.en: Each task uses an independent initial state. Participants complete each attempt without interruption and may take breaks between tasks. This preserves the continuous trajectory needed to measure human interaction time from the initial screen to submission. Because the keyboard agent begins every task with a fresh LLM context as described in Section 3.4.2 , we shuffle the human task order and avoid grouping tasks from the same repository. This arrangement reduces carryover from recently learned application conventions. Participants first attempt every task once, then revisit unsuccessful tasks after the full first round until all tasks pass. Our subsequent analyses are based primarily on each participant’s first attempt completed through the designated + submission. Finally, completing the study takes approximately one to four hours per participant, reflecting variation in familiarity and pace even among experienced terminal users.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都使用一个独立的初始状态。 参与者会不间断地完成每次尝试，但可以在任务之间休息。 这样能保持从初始屏幕到提交过程中测量人类交互时间所需的连续轨迹。 由于键盘智能体在开始每个任务时都会使用如第 3.4.2 节所述的全新 LLM 上下文，因此我们会打乱人类任务的顺序，并避免将来自同一代码库的任务分组。 这种安排减少了近期学习的应用程序惯例带来的影响延续。 参与者首先对每个任务尝试一次，然后在第一轮全部结束后重新尝试未成功的任务，直到所有任务都通过为止。 我们后续的分析主要基于每位参与者通过指定“+”提交按钮完成的第一次尝试。 最后，完成整个研究大约需要每位参与者一到四个小时，这反映了即使是在经验丰富的终端用户中，熟悉度和操作速度也存在差异。

paragraphs.en: All agent experiments follow the keyboard agent design in Section 3.4 , with a maximum of 100 interaction turns per run. We use deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-v4-flash for text-based observations, and the image-capable deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp for image observations. We abbreviate these three evaluators as Pro, Flash, and Vision, respectively. paragraphs.en: Following Section 2.2 , we operationalize the two interaction-cost dimensions with role-specific measures. T H T_{H} spans the initial screen to the first submission, whereas L A L_{A} totals reasoning tokens across turns. N H N_{H} and N A N_{A} follow the shared counting rule in Section 2.2 . In particular, we do not compare the raw values of T H T_{H} and L A L_{A} , but compare their task rankings instead because they use different units.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循第 2.2 节的安排，我们用与角色相关的指标将两个交互成本维度具体化。 对于人类轨迹，交互时间（T H T_{H}）用作解释需求的代理指标，而物理原子关键事件数量（N H N_{H}）则衡量操作量。 对于智能体轨迹，推理令牌长度（L A L_{A}）和虚拟原子关键事件数量（N A N_{A}）分别承担相应的角色。 T H T_{H} 的跨度从初始屏幕到第一次提交，而 L A L_{A} 则是各轮次中推理令牌的总数。 N H N_{H} 和 N A N_{A} 遵循第 2.2 节中共同的计数规则。 具体来说，我们不比较 T H T_{H} 和 L A L_{A} 的原始数值，而是比较它们在任务中的排名，因为它们使用了不同的单位。

paragraphs.en: To characterize interaction composition, we group atomic key events by their observable forms into four classes: printable characters and symbols, navigation keys for cursor or focus movement, deletion keys, and control keys for commands and modifier combinations ( Leijten and Van Waes, 2013 ; Yoon and Myers, 2011 ) . To compare trajectory order, we construct raw-key sequences and class sequences , with the latter mapping events to the four classes and collapsing consecutive repetitions. For each representation, we compute normalized Levenshtein similarity as 1 − d Lev ​ ( s 1 , s 2 ) / max ⁡ ( | s 1 | , | s 2 | ) 1-d_{\mathrm{Lev}}(s_{1},s_{2})/\max(|s_{1}|,|s_{2}|) and normalized longest-common-subsequence ( LCS ) similarity as 2 ​ | LCS ⁡ ( s 1 , s 2 ) | / ( | s 1 | + | s 2 | ) 2|\mathrm{LCS}(s_{1},s_{2})|/(|s_{1}|+|s_{2}|) . paragraphs.en: To systematically evaluate Agent-as-a-User, we formulate the following three research questions (RQs). They progress from human–agent correspondence, through the effect of observation on that correspondence, to the task-based usability of generated TUIs:
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统性地评估“智能体即用户”模式，我们提出了以下三个研究问题（RQ）。 这些问题依次探讨了人类与智能体之间的对应关系、观察对该对应关系的影响，以及所生成的人机界面（TUI）在任务执行中的可用性：

sents.en: To systematically evaluate Agent-as-a-User, we formulate the following three research questions (RQs).
sents.zh: 为了系统性地评估“智能体即用户”模式，我们提出了以下三个研究问题（RQ）。

sents.en: They progress from human–agent correspondence, through the effect of observation on that correspondence, to the task-based usability of generated TUIs:
sents.zh: 这些问题依次探讨了人类与智能体之间的对应关系、观察对该对应关系的影响，以及所生成的人机界面（TUI）在任务执行中的可用性：

paragraphs.en: How do agent completion, the two interaction costs, and the resulting paths correspond to human interaction on the same tasks?
paragraphs.zh: 智能体完成、两种交互成本以及由此产生的路径，与人类在执行相同任务时的交互方式有何对应关系？

paragraphs.en: How do plain, semantic, and image observations affect that correspondence, given that humans see the rendered screen and the agent receives a discrete representation?
paragraphs.zh: 在人类看到渲染后的屏幕而智能体接收到离散表示的情况下，普通的、语义的以及图像类的观察结果会如何影响这种对应关系？

paragraphs.en: What is the task-based usability of TUIs generated by three leading coding agents, relative to the reference TUIs?
paragraphs.zh: 与参考TUI相比，由三大主流编码智能体生成的TUI的任务导向可用性如何？

paragraphs.en: Our analysis covers 3,528 agent attempts and 504 human first attempts from 6 participants across 84 tasks. To answer RQ1, we compare human and agent evaluations of the reference TUIs to identify similarities and differences in completion, the two Agent-KLM costs, and interaction paths. To answer RQ2, we examine how different visual observation encodings affect those measurements across five observation–evaluator configurations. To answer RQ3, we compare each reference TUI with its three independently generated counterparts using the same completion, interpretation, and operation measures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的分析涵盖了来自 6 名参与者在 84 项任务中的 3,528 次智能体尝试和 504 次人类首次尝试。 为回答研究问题 1，我们比较了人类与智能体对参考 TUI 的评估，以识别在完成度、两种 Agent-KLM 成本以及交互路径方面的异同。 为回答研究问题 2，我们考察了不同的视觉观察编码在五种观察–评估者配置中如何影响这些测量指标。 为回答研究问题 3，我们将每个参考 TUI 与其三个独立生成的对应版本进行比较，并使用相同的完成度、解释和操作指标进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Success rate alone cannot establish human–agent usability correspondence. Table 1 summarizes the RQ1 results using deepseek-v4-pro with plain observations as a representative text-based agent configuration. Participants complete 385 of 504 first attempts (76.4%), while the agent completes 209 of 252 independent fresh-context runs (82.9%). Viewed only in aggregate, these rates appear similar. However, their task-level correlation is limited and uncertain ( ρ = 0.35 \rho=0.35 , 95% CI [-0.03, 0.57]). Five tasks have high agent but low human completion rates, while six show the reverse. Overestimation on some tasks and underestimation on others can therefore cancel in the aggregate, making two evaluations appear more closely aligned than they are task by task.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭成功率无法确立人类与智能体在使用性上的对应关系。 表1总结了使用 deepseek-v4-pro 和纯观察作为代表性文本型智能体配置时，RQ1 的研究结果。 参与者在首次尝试中完成了 504 项任务中的 385 项（76.4%），而智能体则在独立的 252 次新上下文运行中完成了 209 项（82.9%）。 仅从总体数据来看，这些完成率似乎相近。 然而，它们在任务层面的相关性有限且不确定（ρ = 0.35 \rho=0.35，95% CI [-0.03, 0.57]）。 有五个任务的智能体完成率较高，但人类完成率较低，而另外六个任务则呈现出相反的情况。 因此，在某些任务上的高估与在其他任务上的低估可能会在总体数据中相互抵消，导致两次评估看起来比实际各任务表现更为一致。

sents.en: Viewed only in aggregate, these rates appear similar.
sents.zh: 仅从总体数据来看，这些完成率似乎相近。

sents.en: However, their task-level correlation is limited and uncertain ( ρ = 0.35 \rho=0.35 , 95% CI [-0.03, 0.57]).
sents.zh: 然而，它们在任务层面的相关性有限且不确定（ρ = 0.35 \rho=0.35，95% CI [-0.03, 0.57]）。

sents.en: Five tasks have high agent but low human completion rates, while six show the reverse.
sents.zh: 有五个任务的智能体完成率较高，但人类完成率较低，而另外六个任务则呈现出相反的情况。

sents.en: Overestimation on some tasks and underestimation on others can therefore cancel in the aggregate, making two evaluations appear more closely aligned than they are task by task.
sents.zh: 因此，在某些任务上的高估与在其他任务上的低估可能会在总体数据中相互抵消，导致两次评估看起来比实际各任务表现更为一致。

paragraphs.en: This limitation is also inherent to the metric. Success rate collapses an entire trajectory into a final pass-or-fail outcome, treating direct completion and completion after extensive exploration alike. It remains informative about whether tasks are completed, but cannot by itself characterize the usability demands encountered along the way. We therefore examine the interaction cost introduced in Section 2.2 through its interpretation cost and operation cost dimensions.

paragraphs.en: Aligned operation costs conceal different interaction habits. The overall operation cost relationship could have a simple mechanical explanation: tasks requiring longer literal input would increase both human and agent key counts. To test whether text entry alone drives the result, we decompose atomic key events into the four analytical key classes defined in Section 4.3.3 . Table 1 shows positive task-level correlations for every class, with all 95% CIs excluding zero. Printable input has the strongest relationship ( ρ = 0.89 \rho=0.89 ), but control ( ρ = 0.65 \rho=0.65 ), navigation ( ρ = 0.48 \rho=0.48 ), and deletion ( ρ = 0.32 \rho=0.32 ) remain related as well. Consistently, aggregating all non-printable events retains a correlation of ρ = 0.48 \rho=0.48 (95% CI [0.06, 0.71]). The operation relationship is therefore not specific to one kind of key: even deletion, despite being rare in agent paths, retains a positive association.
paragraphs.zh: 一致的操作成本掩盖了不同的交互习惯。 整体操作成本之间的关系或许可以用一个简单的机械性解释来说明：需要更长时间字面输入的任务会增加人类和智能体的按键次数。 为了检验是否仅由文本输入导致这一结果，我们将原子级按键事件分解为第 4.3.3 节中定义的四类分析性按键。 表 1 显示，每一类在任务层面都存在正向相关性，且所有 95% 的置信区间均不包含零。 可打印输入的相关性最强（ρ = 0.89），但控制（ρ = 0.65）、导航（ρ = 0.48）和删除（ρ = 0.32）也仍然存在相关性。 与此一致，将所有非可打印事件汇总后，仍保持 ρ = 0.48 的相关性（95% 置信区间 [0.06, 0.71]）。 因此，这种操作关系并非针对某一特定类型的按键：即使删除键在智能体的路径中较为罕见，它仍然保持着正向关联。

paragraphs.en: However, task-level correlation does not imply identical interaction habits. Fig. 6 shows that printable keys account for 73.6% of agent actions but only 42.6% of human actions. In contrast, participants devote 42.4% of their input to navigation, compared with 14.2% for the agent, and also use more deletion (8.2% versus 0.9%). This pattern is consistent with greater agent reliance on literal input and less incremental navigation and correction. Thus, humans and the agent can rank task operation demand similarly while using different key mixtures.

paragraphs.en: Sequence-level alignment increases with human path consistency. Table 2 extends Table 1 from aggregate costs to pairwise path similarity. For each task and pairing type, we take the median similarity before summarizing all 84 tasks. Across the four measures, the median human–agent minus human–human differences range from − 0.03 -0.03 to + 0.05 +0.05 . These small gaps do not consistently favor either pairing. paragraphs.en: Taken together, RQ1 suggests that the agent is better viewed as a measure of task-level interaction demand in Agent-as-a-User. It is not a direct replica of human behavior. Completion alone misses this relationship. Cost analysis shows that the same tasks tend to require more operations from both humans and the agent. Trajectory analysis shows that agent paths align more closely with human paths when humans follow more consistent routes.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，RQ1表明在“智能体即用户”的框架中，更应将智能体视为衡量任务层面交互需求的指标。 它并非人类行为的直接复制品。 仅关注任务完成会忽略这种关系。 成本分析显示，相同任务通常需要人类和智能体执行更多操作。 轨迹分析表明，当人类遵循更一致的路线时，智能体的路径与人类路径的吻合度更高。

paragraphs.en: Claude Code matches the reference in completion but not in usability. sents.en: They cover information visibility, action discoverability, and outcome feedback, matching those in Fig. 1 : blind scanning versus guided navigation, hidden affordances versus visible prompts, and silent failures versus immediate feedback.
sents.zh: 这些案例涵盖了信息可见性、操作可发现性和结果反馈，与图 1 中的内容相对应：盲目扫描与引导式导航、隐藏的操作提示与可见的提示，以及静默失败与即时反馈。

paragraphs.en: Information visibility concerns how clearly the interface presents task-relevant content and system status. P10/T07 asks for Redis ACL users and their rules. Both implementations complete all three runs, but one presents the requested accounts in a table without conflicting messages. The other displays the ACL state while a red unknown command message reports that an ACL operation failed. Mean interaction demand rises from 17.0 to 67.0 AKE and from 3.0k to 21.7k reasoning tokens. The visible failure makes otherwise readable information harder to trust and interpret.
paragraphs.zh: 信息可见性涉及界面呈现任务相关内容和系统状态时的清晰度。 P10/T07 要求提供 Redis ACL 用户及其规则。 两种实现都完成了全部三次运行，但其中一种以表格形式呈现了所需账户，且没有冲突消息。 另一种则在显示 ACL 状态的同时，通过一条红色“未知命令”消息报告 ACL 操作失败。 平均交互需求从 17.0 上升到 67.0 AKE，推理令牌数则从 3.0k 上升到 21.7k。 这种可见的故障使得原本可读的信息更难被信任和解读。

paragraphs.en: Action discoverability concerns how readily the interface reveals the controls needed for a task. In P03/T04, one design opens a rename field without revealing how to replace its contents. The other exposes clearing, segment deletion, cursor movement, confirmation, and cancellation in the active mode. Both implementations complete all runs, yet the path with contextual guidance falls from 35.0 to 16.0 AKE and from 15.0k to 0.5k reasoning tokens. The gain comes from exposing the editing method at the point of action rather than from adding functionality.

paragraphs.en: Outcome feedback concerns how clearly the interface communicates the result of an action. P02/T04 asks the user to append a line to the FLOW-2 card. paragraphs.en: These cases show how interaction cost emerges from concrete interface design choices. Conflicting status information makes visible content harder to trust, contextual guidance reduces trial and error, and explicit confirmation removes ambiguity about whether an update persisted. Weakness in any of these dimensions can increase interpretation or operation cost even when task completion is unchanged. This mechanism-level view explains why the three measures separate in RQ3 ( Nielsen, 1994 ; Tidwell, 2006 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这些案例表明，交互成本是如何源于具体的界面设计决策的。 相互矛盾的状态信息会使可见内容更难被信任，情境引导能减少试错过程，而明确的确认则消除了更新是否已生效的模糊性。 在这些维度中的任何一项存在不足，即使任务完成结果未变，也可能增加解释或操作的成本。 这种机制层面的视角解释了为何在研究问题 3（Nielsen, 1994；Tidwell, 2006）中这三个指标会相互分离。

paragraphs.en: Our findings suggest three research directions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果提出了三个研究方向：

paragraphs.en: Evaluate usability through task execution. Functional correctness shows whether a required state can be reached, but not how the interface supports users in reaching it. This study begins with TUIs because they combine GUI-like visual states with CLI-like keyboard interaction that can be recorded and replayed. The same approach can be extended to web, mobile, desktop, and other interactive software when observations, actions, and outcomes can be captured and verified. This study provides an initial human calibration. An important next step is to test whether the observed relationships transfer across interface types, tasks, users, and evaluators.
paragraphs.zh: 通过任务执行来评估可用性。 功能正确性表明能否达到所需状态，但并未说明界面如何帮助用户实现这一目标。 本研究从 TUI 开始，因为它们结合了类似 GUI 的视觉状态和类似 CLI 的可记录与重放的键盘交互。 当观察、操作和结果能够被捕捉并验证时，同样的方法也可以扩展到网页、移动设备、桌面及其他交互式软件中。 本研究提供了一次初步的人类校准。 一个重要的下一步是测试所观察到的关系是否能在不同界面类型、任务、用户和评估者之间迁移。

paragraphs.en: Our findings suggest two development practices:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果提出了两种开发实践：

paragraphs.en: Make interaction quality an explicit acceptance criterion. Implementations with the same functional scope can differ substantially in completion and interaction demand. During requirements and acceptance testing, development teams can pair functional tests with representative tasks that specify what users must see, which actions must be discoverable, and how outcomes are confirmed. They can then evaluate completion, interpretation, operation, and trajectory evidence together rather than accept an implementation based on its final state alone.
paragraphs.zh: 将交互质量作为明确的验收标准。 功能范围相同的实现方案，在完成任务和交互需求方面可能存在显著差异。 在需求分析和验收测试阶段，开发团队可以将功能测试与典型任务相结合，明确用户必须看到的内容、哪些操作必须可被发现，以及结果如何得到确认。 这样，他们就可以综合评估任务的完成度、解释性、可操作性及过程证据，而不是仅根据最终状态就接受某个实现方案。

paragraphs.en: Use execution-grounded evaluation to prevent usability regressions. All visual interfaces require usability evaluation. Agent-as-a-User provides quantitative task-execution evidence that can complement human evaluation for a more comprehensive assessment of usability. Once representative tasks, outcome checks, and baseline costs exist, development teams can rerun them to detect interaction regressions even when functional tests continue to pass. The same comparisons can rank candidate implementations in generated-software workflows. Together, automated checks and human evaluation can inform development and release decisions.

paragraphs.en: Human calibration. Our human study recruits six experienced terminal users and cannot cover all user populations. Nielsen and Landauer’s model suggests diminishing returns after the first few users in homogeneous formative usability studies ( Nielsen and Landauer, 1993 ) . Our six participants therefore provide an initial homogeneous calibration rather than population-wide validation. The main conclusions are further supported by hierarchical bootstrap inference with 95% confidence intervals from 10,000 resamples over repositories, tasks, participants, and agent runs, and the cost relationships recur across all five evaluator configurations. Validation with more diverse users and counterbalanced task orders remains future work.
paragraphs.zh: 人类校准。 我们的人类研究招募了六名经验丰富的终端用户，无法覆盖所有用户群体。 Nielsen 和 Landauer 的模型表明，在同质化的形成性可用性研究中，前几名用户之后的收益会递减（Nielsen 和 Landauer，1993）。 因此，我们的六名参与者提供的是一种初步的同质化校准，而非覆盖整个群体的验证。 主要结论还得到了分层自助推断的进一步支持，该推断基于对仓库、任务、参与者和智能体运行进行 10,000 次重采样得到的 95% 置信区间，并且成本关系在所有五种评估者配置中均重复出现。 使用更多样化的用户和经过平衡的任务顺序进行验证仍属于未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: Measurement scope. Usability spans effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction for specified users, goals, and contexts ( International Organization for Standardization, 2018 ) , and no single measure captures it fully ( Hornbæk, 2006 ) . We focus on task-based usability, using task completion and interaction demand as reproducible execution evidence. This scope excludes subjective experience, learning, and accessibility. The evaluator experiments test a common paradigm rather than rank models. The keyboard agent is intentionally minimal, with fresh context and no external tools, skills, or complex context management. This design keeps the agent as closely aligned with a human user as possible and reduces the influence of other agent configurations. We also repeat each task three times and report five configurations separately. Objective measurement of additional usability dimensions remains future work.

paragraphs.en: KLM and GOMS predict skilled human performance by decomposing a specified method into elementary operators ( Card et al., 1980 ; Card et al., 2018 ; John and Kieras, 1996 ) . CogTool partially automates this analysis but still produces predicted execution time ( John et al., 2004 ) . These models assume a largely error-free expert path and therefore do not capture exploration or recovery on a newly encountered interface. Heuristic inspection and earlier automation likewise complement participant studies rather than replace them ( Nielsen, 1994 ; Ivory and Hearst, 2001 ) .
paragraphs.zh: KLM 和 GOMS 通过将指定方法分解为基本操作符来预测熟练的人类表现（Card 等，1980；Card 等，2018；John 和 Kieras，1996）。 CogTool 部分自动化了这一分析过程，但仍会生成预测的执行时间（John 等，2004）。 这些模型假设专家操作路径基本无误，因此无法捕捉到在首次接触新界面时的探索或恢复过程。 启发式检查及早期的自动化方法同样是对参与者研究的补充，而非替代（Nielsen，1994；Ivory 和 Hearst，2001）。

paragraphs.en: Recent LLM systems mainly simulate users, collect think-aloud reports, predict ratings, or score interfaces as judges ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Griesbach et al., 2026 ; Holter et al., 2026 ; Bougie et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Questionnaires and preference studies similarly capture subjective experience rather than verified task execution. These approaches provide useful evidence, but they do not measure interaction cost from verified task executions. Agent-as-a-User instead proposes an execution-grounded paradigm in which a fixed evaluator executes predefined tasks, deterministic oracles verify completion, and Agent-KLM records interpretation and operation costs along the realized trajectory rather than a judged usability score.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的 LLM 系统主要模拟用户、收集出声思考报告、预测评分，或作为评判者对界面进行打分（Lu et al., 2025；Griesbach et al., 2026；Holter et al., 2026；Bougie et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026）。 问卷和偏好研究同样捕捉的是主观体验，而非经过验证的任务执行过程。 这些方法提供了有用的证据，但它们并未衡量经过验证的任务执行所产生的交互成本。 “智能体即用户”方法则提出了一种以执行为基础的模式：一个固定的评估者执行预定义任务，确定性预言机验证任务完成状态，而“智能体-KLM”则记录实际执行路径上的解释与操作成本，而非一个经过评判的可用性分数。

paragraphs.en: Computer-use and terminal benchmarks such as OSWorld, Terminal-Bench, and TUA-Bench evaluate whether agents can complete tasks in real environments ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Their target construct is agent capability, and programmatic oracles separate traces from completion judgments ( Barr et al., 2015 ) . Recent TUI testing work compares LLM-guided and random exploration for coverage and crash discovery ( Peng et al., 2026a ) . Our oracles instead encode user goals, and Agent-KLM characterizes the interaction cost of reaching those goals. Generated-interface work such as AUI-Gym uses computer-use agents to judge newly generated GUIs by task solvability and navigation success, then redesigns those sites toward agent-native completion ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . Agent success on a generated website is a design objective, not a measurement of TUI interaction demand. Prior work therefore shows that agents can operate interfaces, generate UX feedback, and test interactive software. The remaining gap is a repeatable way to measure TUI interaction cost from verified task executions without an LLM usability score. TUINaut addresses this gap through actor-independent oracles, atomic keyboard traces, agent-native interpretation expenditure, human relationship characterization, and observation-representation sensitivity.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we conduct an empirical study of Agent-as-a-User for measuring task-based TUI usability. We introduce Agent-KLM to separate interpretation and operation costs, and develop TUINaut and TUINaut-Bench to support reproducible evaluation. We evaluate them across 84 tasks, 15 reference TUIs, six human participants, five observation–evaluator configurations, and 45 generated counterparts. We find weak human–agent completion correspondence but aligned cost rankings, especially for operation. This pattern persists across observation settings. Generated TUIs can complete the required tasks, yet their task-based usability still needs improvement. These findings position Agent-as-a-User as a repeatable and execution-grounded paradigm for measuring task-based usability.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们对“智能体即用户”方法进行了实证研究，以衡量基于任务的 TUI 可用性。 我们提出了 Agent-KLM 来分离解释成本与操作成本，并开发了 TUINaut 和 TUINaut-Bench 以支持可重复的评估。 我们在 84 项任务、15 个参考 TUI、六名人类参与者、五种观察-评估者配置以及 45 个生成的对应体上对这些方法进行了评估。 我们发现人类与智能体的任务完成度之间存在较弱的对应关系，但成本排名具有一致性，尤其是在操作方面。 这种模式在不同观察设置下均保持一致。 生成的 TUI 能够完成所需任务，但其基于任务的可用性仍需改进。 这些发现确立了“智能体即用户”作为一种可重复且以执行为基础的、衡量基于任务可用性的范式。
